### FileToolName

```ts
type FileToolName = "read" | "list" | "glob" | "grep" | "apply_patch";
```

Closed set of direct, model-visible Files tools; widening one is an ADR.

---

### FileTool

```ts
type FileTool = LabelledTool &
  Readonly<{
    [fileToolBrand]: true;
  }> &
  Readonly<{
    descriptor: Readonly<{
      name: FileToolName;
    }>;
    module: "files";
    access: Access;
  }>;
```

A `MuleTool` minted only by this module, named from the closed `FileToolName`
set. No host can construct one: the brand has no public constructor, so a
host-made `MuleTool` fails typecheck against `files?`.

---

## Functions

### edit()

```ts
function edit(
  port,
  input,
  context,
): Promise<
  | {
      path: string;
      bytes: number;
      diff: string;
      firstChangedLine: number | null;
      unifiedPatch: string | null;
      unifiedPatchBytes: number;
      unifiedPatchAddedLines: number;
      unifiedPatchRemovedLines: number;
      unifiedPatchTruncated: boolean;
    }
  | {
      status: "failed";
      error: {
        kind:
          | "not-found"
          | "ambiguous"
          | "file-too-large"
          | "partial-character"
          | "unchanged"
          | "conflict";
        path: string;
        message: string;
      };
    }
>;
```

Apply the same edit behavior as the Files edit operation directly through a
captured FilesPort.

| `input.newText` | `string`                                                          |
| `context`       | `InvocationContext`                                               |
